The '''Bullhead''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the [[The Mountain|mountain lake]] and [[Farm Maps#Wilderness|Wilderness Farm]] during all seasons. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It may also randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Wednesday|Wednesdays]] for {{Price|200}}, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|75}}.

==Map==
The Bullhead can be found in the mountain lake.

==Tailoring==
Bullhead can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Fishing Vest]].  [[File:Shirt157.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Bullheads can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The only possible output is dark brown Bullhead [[Roe]].

==Quests==
Two Bullhead may be requested by [[Dorado]], [[Lingcod]], or [[Pike]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.
